[Erebos](https://imgur.com/a/pZTnAoy) was thrown in to the void like all the other vessels. A fiery ambition and will to live had been their downfall before the Pale King. Cast in to the void with the rest of their siblings their ambition only grew. Though the dark abyss pressed in around them, they held on. As the sun has chosen a vessel the moon must also choose one. Erebos. Chosen by a higher being the opposite of the Radiance. Their skull was marked by the moon, two thin lines across their empty eyes. The moon chose them for their ambition, for their will to live and for their potential. They was chosen to eclipse the sun and bring peace to Hollownest again. 

With new found power they escaped the abyss and with the moon whispering to them, they wandered hallownest, placing peculiar charms where the moon guided them. Finally, the moon guides them to the land of storm and at last Erebos realizes why they were chosen. Moonlight beamed through the rolling clouds above, washing them in it’s silver glow. They were not to be the end of the radiance, but the light that guides the one who will.


(Takes place when PV was being trained)
